title: Tom DeLonge narrative of a Majestic-style controlling group

tellings.quote: basically the Tom Delong narrative right where he's like gota is basically of the mayard group

plain: The musician turned UFO campaigner Tom DeLonge tells a story in which a secret group much like Majestic, or MJ-12, the name of an alleged committee of officials said to have controlled the UFO secret since the late 1940s, runs the whole matter, according to a national security analyst named Matthew Pines. Pines sums it up for Michels as "basically the Tom DeLonge narrative," in which the people in control are basically a Majestic-style group. If true, it would mean a small hidden body, not elected leaders, decides what the public learns about UFOs.
